title: DataCatalogOutput
description: Represents options that specify how and where in the Glue Data Catalog DataBrew writes the output generated by recipe jobs.

allOf.description: The unique identifier of the Amazon Web Services account that holds the Data Catalog that stores the data.
The name of a database in the Data Catalog.
The name of a table in the Data Catalog.
Represents options that specify how and where DataBrew writes the Amazon S3 output generated by recipe jobs.
Represents options that specify how and where DataBrew writes the database output generated by recipe jobs.
A value that, if true, means that any data in the location specified for output is overwritten with new output. Not supported with DatabaseOptions.
